info.name: ESIA API
info.description:
ESIA Backend - Auto-generated Postman Collection v2.1
Generated: 2026-09-21
Updated: 2026-09-25 - Added Orders (simplified flow)

Base URL via nginx (docker): http://localhost
Direct backend (dev): http://localhost:5000

Auth: Bearer {{accessToken}} (JWT accessToken, 15m expiry)
Refresh: {{refreshToken}} (7d, rotation)
Rate limit: /api/auth -> 10 req/min, /api/* -> 1000/15min

Folders:
- 01 Health & Root
- 02 Auth Public (/api/auth)
- 03 Auth Authenticated (/api/auth/me)
- 04 Categories (/api/categories)
- 05 Products (/api/products)
- 06 Orders (/api/orders)

variable.description: Direct backend (npm run dev). For docker/nginx use http://localhost
JWT access token - auto-set by login/refresh tests
Opaque refresh token - auto-set by login/refresh tests

request.description:
Root probe - no auth. Returns { message: "ESIA API is running", status: "ok" }
Defined in Backend/src/app.ts:64

Mirrored health - app.ts:70 - { status: "ok", message: "Backend is running" }

Also available as /api/v1

item.name: 02 - Auth Public (/api/auth)
item.description: No Bearer required. Rate-limited: 10 req/min (authLimiter in app.ts:58).

request.description:
Public. controller: auth.controller.ts:6, service: auth.service.ts:19
Requires: name, email, password, phone optional.
Password policy: >=8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, 1 special (!@#$%^&* etc.), no spaces. Example: "Password123!"
201 -> { success:true, data:{ id, name, email, phone } }
400 if weak password, 409 if email exists. Email lowercased.

exec: if (json.data && json.data.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', json.data.accessToken); console.log('accessToken set'); }

request.description:
Public unified login (single endpoint). auth.controller.ts:12, auth.service.ts:39
Accepts identifier|email|username + password. Checks Admin table first, then User table. Returns role accordingly.
200 -> { accessToken (JWT 15m, role claim), refreshToken (opaque 7d), tokenExpiration, refreshTokenExpiration, deviceId, user:{id,name,email,role:"user"|"admin"} }
Test script auto-saves tokens to collection variables.

exec: // rotation: old token invalidated, new pair issued - token.service.ts rotateRefreshToken

request.description:
Public but requires valid refreshToken in body (NOT header). auth.controller.ts:28, auth.service.ts:91
Rotates token: old deleted, new pair returned. 401 if invalid/expired/revoked.
Test script auto-updates {{accessToken}} and {{refreshToken}}.

Public, revokes refresh token. auth.controller.ts:34, auth.service.ts:134
Body: { refreshToken }. If omitted, still 200 but nothing revoked. Always 200 { success:true, data:null }.

item.name: 03 - Auth Authenticated (/api/auth/me)
item.description: Requires Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}. All use protect middleware (auth.middleware.ts:29). Token from ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET / JWT_SECRET (15m default). [Endpoints removed per request]

item.name: 04 - Categories (/api/categories)
item.description: Category CRUD. Public reads (GET), admin writes (POST/PATCH/DELETE). Routes: Backend/src/routes/category.routes.ts:14, Controller: Backend/src/controllers/category.controller.ts. Mounted at /api/categories and /api/v1/categories via routes/index.ts. Admin = protect + adminOnly (auth.middleware.ts:69) requires Bearer {{accessToken}} with role=admin. Slug auto-generated from name via slugify() if not provided.

request.description:
Public. category.controller.ts:getCategoryById. Param id must be integer.
200 -> { success:true, data:{id,name,slug} }
400 if invalid id, 404 if not found.
Also available as /api/v1/categories/:id

Admin only (protect + adminOnly). category.controller.ts:createCategory
Requires Bearer {{accessToken}} with role=admin (login as admin@esia.local / Admin123!).
Body: { name (required), slug (optional) } -> slug normalized via slugify().
201 -> { success:true, message:"Category created successfully", data:{id,name,slug}, statusCode:201 }
400 if validation fails, 401 if no token, 403 if not admin, 409 if name or slug already exists.

Admin only (protect + adminOnly). category.controller.ts:updateCategory. Route: PATCH /api/categories/:id (PUT removed).
Requires Bearer admin token. At least one of name/slug must be provided.
200 -> { success:true, message:"Category updated successfully", data:{id,name,slug}, statusCode:200 }
400 if no fields or invalid, 404 if not found, 409 if duplicate name/slug.

Admin only (protect + adminOnly). category.controller.ts:deleteCategory
Requires Bearer admin token. Deletes category by id; FK ON DELETE CASCADE will also delete its products (see migrations/1710000000000-Init.ts:30).
200 -> { success:true, message:"Category deleted successfully", data:null, statusCode:200 }
400 if invalid id, 404 if not found, 401/403 if not admin.

item.name: 05 - Products (/api/products)
item.description: Product CRUD — Public reads (GET), admin writes (POST + media management). Routes: Backend/src/routes/product.routes.ts:12, Controller: Backend/src/controllers/product.controller.ts (colors by ID, cloned via In(); images via multer+sharp). Mounted at /api/products and /api/v1/products via routes/index.ts. ProductColor 3-field split: nameEn/nameAr/hexCode each unique per product (ProductColor.ts:5). Images: multer diskStorage safe-ext, 3MB limit, sharp 80 quality, /uploads/products/images, main is order 0 via sortOrder + mainImageUrl. Admin = protect + adminOnly requires Bearer {{accessToken}} with role=admin.

query.description: Filter by category id OR use categorySlug/dresses slug. Omit for all.

request.description:
Public. product.controller.ts:getAllProducts — LIST view (card outside). Returns ONLY main image + basics for grid . Supports category filter: ?categoryId=1 (int) or ?categorySlug=dresses or ?category=dresses|1 or ?slug=dresses. Query params: categoryId, categorySlug, category, slug. If category not found → [] 200. Images in list are filtered to only isMain=true (single) for lightweight payload; mainImageUrl also provided for quick card. For full details with all images, use GET /api/products/:id (details).

Response shape for list (basic): [{ id, name, categoryId, category:{id,name,slug}, price, oldPrice, tag, isActive, mainImageUrl, mainImage:{id,imageUrl,sortOrder,isMain}, images:[mainImage], colors:[{id,nameEn,nameAr,hexCode}], createdAt }]

Examples: GET /api/products, GET /api/products?categoryId=1, GET /api/products?categorySlug=dresses, GET /api/products?category=bags
Also available as /api/v1/products.

item.name: POST /api/products - Create (Admin) - Multipart (: multer + sharp compress + 3MB limit)

formdata.value: Demo dress - puff sleeves default shape

formdata.description: JSON-stringified array of ProductColor IDs (cloned via In()) — e.g. [1,2] where 1=pink,2=black

FILE — local/storage upload (multer diskStorage -> uploads/products/images/<unique>.jpg, 3MB limit, sharp compressed). If sent together with image[0].url for SAME index, FILE wins and url is ignored (as requested).

Bool — true makes this image the main for card outside (is_main=true, partial unique). Only one true per product; if BOTH file and url for same index, isMain still applies to that single image (file wins).

URL — online image (https://...), saved as-is in DB (e.g. https://cdn.com/img.jpg, deleteFile skips http). Only used if image[0] file NOT provided for same index. If BOTH file and url sent for same index 0, FILE is used and url is ignored.
FILE — local/storage upload for index 1. Same rule: if image[1].url also sent for same index, file wins.

Bool — true makes this image the main for card outside (is_main=true, partial unique). Only one true per product; if BOTH file and url for same index, isMain still applies to that single image (file wins).
URL — online image for index 1. Example external URL alternative to file — will be stored as-is (deleteFile skips http). Ignored if image[1] file also sent for same index.
URL — online-only example without file (e.g. /uploads/custom.jpg or https://...). Stored as ProductImage with isMain false. Demonstrates url-only usage.

Bool — true makes this image the main for card outside (is_main=true, partial unique). Only one true per product; if BOTH file and url for same index, isMain still applies to that single image (file wins).

request.description:
Admin only — best + frontend-easy indexed images (image[0] pattern) — isMain bool is the ONLY main selector (no mainImageIndex).

Flow (multer + sharp + isMain for card):
1) Multer diskStorage safe mimeToExt → uploads/products/images/<Date.now>-<rand>.jpg, fileFilter jpg/png/webp/gif, limits 30MB, fieldname image[0] / image[0].file / images[0] all accepted (upload.middleware.ts:21).
2) processMedia validates image ≤3MB else 400 + deletes batch, sharp compresses parallel (jpeg80/png6/webp80) via temp file (media.middleware.ts:11, media.service.ts:11).
3) Controller parseIndexedImages(req.body, files) builds map image[0] -> {file, url, isMain, sortOrder}, merges file+url, sorts, normalizes sortOrder 0..n, determines main SOLELY by per-index isMain bool (exactly one true enforced, partial unique index UQ_product_images_main; if none true, first image becomes main; if multiple true → 400). Syncs products.main_image_url to isMain image for fast card lookup.
4) Also supports legacy: fieldname images/files + body.images JSON (with isMain) — both work.
5) Storage served via app.ts:83 /uploads static. Cleanup on rollback via fileUtils.deleteFile.

Indexed example curl (frontend-easy):
 curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/products -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -F "name=Puff Sleeve Dress" -F "categoryId=1" -F "price=1299" -F "colors=[1,2]" -F "sizes=[\"S\",\"M\"]" \
 -F "image[0]=@/path/img1.jpg" -F "image[0].isMain=true" \
 -F "image[1]=@/path/img2.jpg" -F "image[1].isMain=false" \
 -F "image[2].url=https://example.com/ext.jpg" -F "image[2].isMain=false"

List view (GET /api/products) returns only main image for card; details (GET /:id) returns all images with isMain flags.

formdata.description: FILE — local/storage upload image[0] (multer -> uploads/products/images, sharp). If image[0].url also sent for same index, FILE wins.
Bool — true makes this new image the main for card (clears old main via isMain).
URL — online image for index 2 (no file), saved as-is. Ignored if image[2] file also sent.
Bool — false for non-main. If image[2] file also sent with url for same index, file wins but isMain still applies.

request.description:
Admin only (protect + adminOnly, upload.any() + processMedia). product.controller.ts:addProductImages — mirrors addMedia but with indexed support.
Accepts indexed: image[0] file + image[0].isMain + image[0].url (frontend-easy) OR legacy images/files + body images array / imageUrl. Files validated 3MB, sharp compressed, appended with nextOrder = max(sortOrder)+1. If any new image has isMain=true, clears existing is_main via UPDATE ... WHERE is_main=true, sets new main, syncs mainImageUrl. If no isMain, keeps existing main. Example: POST /api/products/1/images -F "image[0]=@new.jpg" -F "image[0].isMain=true" . Returns updated product with sorted images (isMain flags).
Also available as POST /api/products/:id/media.

Admin only. product.controller.ts:removeProductImage — mirrors DELETE /:id/media (removeMedia by order).
Param :order is sortOrder (preferred) or image id — finds image where sortOrder==order or id==order. Physically deletes file via fileUtils.deleteFile (skips http), removes DB row, then re-normalizes remaining sortOrders to 0,1,2... like (map idx). If removed was mainImageUrl, updates main to new first image (order 0) else null.
Also supports DELETE /api/products/:id/media with body {order} or {imageId}.
200 -> { success:true, data:{updated product}}
404 if product or image not found.

Admin only. product.controller.ts:reorderProductImages — mirrors PUT /:id/media/reorder (product.service reorderMedia).
Body: { currentOrder:number, newOrder:number }. Finds image by sortOrder==currentOrder, shifts others between old/new by ±1 , sets item.order=newOrder, re-sorts, updates mainImageUrl to new first (order 0) if changed.
Also available as PUT /api/products/:id/media/reorder.
200 -> { success:true, data:{images sorted}}
400 if missing/invalid orders, 404 if product or image not found.

item.name: PATCH /api/products/:id/images/main - Set main (Admin) - isMain for card

request.description:
Admin only (protect + adminOnly). product.controller.ts:setMainProductImage — sets isMain boolean for card display (outside show).
Body: { imageId:number } or { order:number } or { sortOrder:number } — finds by id or sortOrder. Clears existing is_main via UPDATE ... WHERE product_id=:pid, sets target is_main=true, syncs products.main_image_url to target.imageUrl for fast card lookup.
Also available as PUT /api/products/:id/images/main and PATCH /api/products/:id/media/main.
200 -> { success:true, data:{updated product with images sorted, isMain flags}, statusCode:200 }
400 if missing/invalid, 404 if product/image not found.

item.name: 06 - Orders (/api/orders)
item.description: Simplified order flow: Create order with optional payment (guest or auth) → Admin verifies/rejects payment → Admin updates order status. All mounted at /api/orders and /api/v1/orders via order.routes.ts. Auth: user routes need Bearer {{accessToken}} with role=user, admin routes need role=admin. Payment status: NOT_SUBMITTED → SUBMITTED → VERIFIED/REJECTED. Order status: PENDING → PENDING_PAYMENT → ACCEPTED → SHIPPED → DELIVERED (or REJECTED/CANCELLED).

item.name: POST /api/orders - Create Order (Public) - With optional payment

request.description: Public (guest) or Authenticated. Creates order. If payment fields provided, creates order with PENDING_PAYMENT status and SUBMITTED payment status. If no payment fields, creates order with PENDING status and NOT_SUBMITTED payment status. Returns orderNumber for tracking. Also available as /api/v1/orders
Public. Returns full order details including items, payment info, status timeline. No auth required. Also available as /api/v1/orders/track/:orderNumber

query.description: Filter: pending | pending_payment | accepted | rejected | shipped | delivered | cancelled

request.description: User only (protect + userOnly). Paginated list of user's orders. Supports status & paymentStatus filters. Also available as /api/v1/orders/my-orders
User only. Returns single order with full details. Also available as /api/v1/orders/my-orders/:id

query.description: Filter: pending | pending_payment | accepted | rejected | shipped | delivered | cancelled
Search by orderNumber, customerName, email, phone

request.description: Admin only (protect + adminOnly). Paginated list with status, paymentStatus filters and search. Also available as /api/v1/orders
Admin only. Returns single order with full details. Also available as /api/v1/orders/:id

Admin only. Updates order status with validation. Valid transitions: PENDING→PENDING_PAYMENT/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/CANCELLED, PENDING_PAYMENT→ACCEPTED/REJECTED/CANCELLED, ACCEPTED→SHIPPED/CANCELLED/REJECTED, SHIPPED→DELIVERED/CANCELLED. Auto-sets reviewedBy/reviewedAt. Also available as /api/v1/orders/:id/status

Admin only. Verifies or rejects submitted payment. On verify: order status becomes ACCEPTED, paymentStatus VERIFIED. On reject: order status REJECTED, paymentStatus REJECTED with reason. Also available as /api/v1/orders/:id/verify-payment
Admin only. Updates internal admin notes on order. Also available as /api/v1/orders/:id/notes

item.name: 07 - Cart (/api/cart)
item.description: Cart persistence for guests and authenticated users. Guests use x-guest-token header, users use Bearer token. All endpoints work with both auth types. Cart auto-created on first add. Variant matching by productId + color + size.

header.description: Required for guests. Auto-generated on first request if not provided.

request.description: Public or Authenticated. Returns cart with items, product details, totals. Use x-guest-token header for guests, or Bearer {{accessToken}} for users. Also available as /api/v1/cart
Public or Authenticated. Adds item to cart (creates cart if needed). If same variant exists, increments quantity. Returns updated cart with totals. Also available as /api/v1/cart/items
Public or Authenticated. Updates item quantity. Set quantity: 0 to remove item. Returns updated cart. Also available as /api/v1/cart/items/:itemId
Public or Authenticated. Removes specific cart item. Returns updated cart. Also available as /api/v1/cart/items/:itemId
Public or Authenticated. Removes all items from cart. Returns { data: null }. Also available as /api/v1/cart

User only (Bearer token required). Merges guest cart (identified by guestToken) into authenticated user's cart. Combines quantities for matching variants. Returns merged user cart. Also available as /api/v1/cart/merge
